summary: Phase 2.2A backend + frontend fully validated. New backend suite test_phase2_2a_api.py: 19/19 PASS — login by email/CPF (formatted & digits-only), professionals-public for any role, admin-only /api/users list (403 for recepcao), create/update/delete/reset-password/change-password (first-access flag toggles correctly), signed URL upload + auth-less GET via ?sig=, invalid sig and missing sig both rejected, appointments persist professional_color and professional sees only own. Regression: 77/78 prior tests still pass (one outdated phase-2 test uses deprecated ?auth= query param — see action items). Frontend: Login page renders Email/CPF toggle (toggle-auth-email + toggle-auth-cpf), CPF field swaps in (login-cpf). Admin login → dashboard → nav-equipe visible. /equipe team-page shown; new-user-btn opens user-form with all required testids (user-name/email/cpf/role/color-*/pwd/save-btn). Creating new professional adds row and login flow triggers change-password-modal (cp-new/cp-confirm/cp-submit) which closes after submit. /agenda shows colored appointment cards (left-border per professional) and professionals-legend with all names+colors. Photo from /api/files served with 200/image/png.

minor.issue: Old regression test_phase2_api.py::TestUploads::test_upload_and_serve_via_query_auth still expects deprecated ?auth=<jwt> query param. Implementation moved to ?sig=<signed-token>. Test is outdated, not a backend bug.

action_items: Optionally update /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_api.py::TestUploads to use new ?sig= signed-URL scheme (test_phase2_2a_api.py already covers this). Currently 1/78 regression failure is purely the outdated test, not a server bug.
Consider adding data-testid attributes for the per-appointment card (e.g. appointment-card-<id>) and the lightbox prev/next/close buttons to enable deeper Playwright validation in future iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py >2000 lines now — split into routers/{auth,users,files,appointments,patients,clinic,public,mobile_upload,messages,ai}. Phase 2.2A code lives mostly in lines 290-340, 497-565, 1154-1235, 1898-2025.
Signed URL JWT (sig) uses same secret as access tokens. Acceptable, but consider a distinct shorter-lived secret/audience to limit blast radius if access JWT leaks.

PUT /api/users/{id} requires full StaffUserIn body (re-supplying name/email/role) even when only the initial_password should change — frontend Equipe.jsx must therefore re-send all fields. Consider a PATCH semantics or separate /api/users/{id}/initial-password endpoint to mirror /reset-password.

Old photos saved before signed URL change are stored as bare /api/files/... paths without ?sig=. They still serve OK while a session cookie/token is available, but will 401 when accessed cross-origin without auth (mobile/external links). Consider a one-shot migration to append signature on read for legacy docs.
